description: Canonical registry of all TOURney plans, reviews, audits, and QA artifacts. The /platform Artifacts tab renders from this file. Skills (e.g. tourney-review) append new entries when they generate output.

entries.title: Full Platform Review · May 8, 2026
entries.summary: Weekly scheduled review. Grades: Architecture A, Feature Depth B+, UX B, Security B-, Business Ready C+, Deployment B+, Performance B, Data Model B. Top open issues: send-push zero auth in production (fix committed not deployed), send-install-email no auth fix, CSP unsafe-inline. Business blocked on LLC formation. 11 migrations tracked. Stripe fully wired. Council of 5: loading skeletons, tournament series schema, ToS/Privacy gate, CI on push, handicap-adjusted scoreboard.
entries.author: Claude Sonnet 4.6

entries.title: Business Plan: Claude Token Spend · May 7, 2026
entries.summary: Financial case for cutting GKS Anthropic spend 25-50%. Status quo $55/mo -> conservative $41/mo (27% saved) or aggressive $30/mo (45% saved). Stacked savings model, decision framework (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus by task class), risk register, 7-step adoption sprint with verification gates. Annual savings $264 reinvested into TOURney customer infra.
entries.author: Claude Opus 4.7 + Claude Code Guide SME

entries.title: Claude Token Burn Review · May 7, 2026
entries.summary: Why GKS Anthropic spend is too high and the 5-step plan to cut 25-40% without quality loss. Top wins: cache CLAUDE.md breakpoint, demote Opus->Sonnet/Haiku, swap Read->ctx_execute_file. Sourced from claude-code-guide SME brief + this machine's settings.json audit.

entries.title: Full Platform Review · May 6, 2026
entries.summary: Code-to-business audit, council of 5 polish ideas, full QA protocol, business roadmap (LLC → PSP), security analysis. Security graded D+ — three CRITICAL/HIGH findings (player_accounts RLS, invitations RLS, admin.html XSS). All other axes A-/B+.
entries.author: Claude Sonnet 4.6

entries.title: Security Review · May 7, 2026
entries.summary: Full security audit. Grade: B−. 2 critical findings (invitations anon-update USING true, send-install-email no auth). 2 high (auth manage invitations open, player_accounts billing data exposed to anon). CSP unsafe-inline nullifies XSS protection. _parseMentions XSS surface in trash talk. Stripe webhook and create-checkout correctly auth-gated. No key leaks. 10-item remediation sprint.
entries.author: Claude Sonnet 4.6

entries.title: Security Hardening Plan · May 7, 2026
entries.summary: Closes all findings from 5-7-26 security review (B−) + outstanding items from 5-6-26 full review. 3 critical fixes (invitations RLS, accept-invitation edge fn, send-install-email auth). 4 high fixes (parseMentions XSS, safeUrl admin, git audit, player_accounts RLS). Pre-launch: magic link auth, CSP unsafe-inline removal, server-side score validation. Phase 2: audit log, multi-tenant RLS, rate limiting, GDPR deletion. 12 sequenced sprint items.
entries.author: Claude Sonnet 4.6

entries.title: Security Runbook · May 7, 2026
entries.summary: Step-by-step operational runbook for the 5-7-26 security hardening plan. 9 steps, ~5h. Covers migration 012 (invitations/player_accounts RLS), send-install-email auth gate, accept-invitation edge function, parseMentions XSS fix, safeUrl() admin fix, magic link auth, CSP unsafe-inline removal. Each step includes exact SQL/commands, verification checkpoint, and rollback procedure.
entries.author: Claude Sonnet 4.6

entries.title: AAA Implementation Plan · A+ across Architecture · Feature Depth · UX Polish
entries.summary: 22 sequenced sprints, ~38 dev-days, taking three product axes to A+. Foundation sprints already shipped: design tokens, shared util lib, observability stub, empty-state library, copy-link component, offline indicator, print stylesheet, migration drafts (006 drop_is_admin, 007 round_model).
